scope: Actual Java RPCClient and native libcurl HTTP(S): request method/path/header values/body, response text/UTF8/line removal, status errors, same/cross host and protocol redirects, auth stripping and POST method/header reset, TLS rejection and configured CA verification. Native queued notification integration uses the production HTTP default, filtering, listener mutation, redirects and failure logging. Header order and selected VM/provider-generated diagnostic text normalized; custom global JDK properties/authenticator/proxy/cookie/cache and all native SSLContext providers remain unverified.
